description: This is a source file for an Android Wear OS watch face, specifically an analog watch face with a second hand, including handling ambient mode, styling, drawing, and system integrations.

classes.name: AnalogWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService for rendering the watch face.

classes.name: AnalogWatchFaceService.Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine responsible for watch face rendering, updates, and system event handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes watch face style, paints, loads background images, and sets up palettes.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Handles property changes related to low-bit ambient and burn-in protection.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Triggers redraw every minute in ambient mode.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Adjusts rendering style based on ambient mode.

methods.name: onInterruptionFilterChanged
methods.description: Pauses or dims UI when device is in mute mode.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Recalculates dimensions, scales background images, and initializes gray background for ambient mode.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Main rendering routine drawing background, tick marks, and clock hands based on current time and mode.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Registers or unregisters broadcast receivers and updates time when visible.

methods.name: updateTimer
methods.description: Controls the update handler based on visibility and ambient mode.
